limits: Two seeds and one fixed party base: Traveler, Xiangling, Fischl, support. Not every possible party, artifact, constellation, stage-element or account.
Initial ownership/progression/gear are explicit diagnostic fixtures; native rewards, HP, XP, cooldowns, enemies, lodging, travel and time rules remain intact.
Inn cost zero is not proof of successful free recovery: normalize failed final recovery to innCostComparable null. Travel fights can heal missing HP before reaching inn.
Lv15 experience can cause levels and full-HP reward recovery. Separate post-reward gains and battle healing.
Formation adds combat-only HP to third actor, so effective healing can exceed same-battle HP damage; main healing metrics are actual Runtime.heal results, not assumed overheal.
Baseline fingerprint describes original loaded source and DB before VM substitutions; candidateSources records exact replacement source and modified VM source hashes.
All normal Q1.5 and talent healing multipliers, attack damage, AI, existing targets, fields duration, cooldown and XP/food/lodging rules preserved.
No desired lodging-saving percentage was forced. Safety, wins/KO, time and resources are separate outcomes.
